versions.content: The ADC module's environment shall ensure that the application buffer, which address is passed as parameter in Adc_SetupResultBuffer, has the ac- cording size to hold all group channel conversion results and if streaming access is selected, hold these results multiple times as specified with streaming sample param- eter (see ADC292).
